integrations.name: Zendesk Ticket and Sidebar Integration
integrations.auth_approach: OAuth 2.0 and signed JWT verification via Zendesk Apps Framework.
integrations.error_handling: Failed requests return HTTP error codes and fall back to manual agent processing.
integrations.retry_behavior: Exponential backoff up to 3 retry attempts for transient API errors.
integrations.monitoring: Monitored via Application Telemetry and Monitoring for latency and error rates.
integrations.sync_considerations: Real-time event processing for ticket updates and streaming draft responses.

integrations.name: Confluence Cloud Knowledge Ingestion
integrations.target_system: Enterprise Vector and Hybrid Search Index
integrations.auth_approach: OAuth 2.0 API tokens with read permissions.
integrations.error_handling: Failed page extractions are logged and flagged for retry on the next sync cycle.
integrations.retry_behavior: Automated batch retry up to 3 attempts per document chunk.
integrations.monitoring: Monitored via ingestion pipeline completion metrics and log alerts.
integrations.sync_considerations: Bi-weekly batch synchronization aligning with product release cycles.

integrations.name: GitHub Markdown Documentation Ingestion
integrations.target_system: Enterprise Vector and Hybrid Search Index
integrations.auth_approach: GitHub Personal Access Tokens or App authentication.
integrations.error_handling: Malformed Markdown files are skipped and recorded in execution logs.
integrations.retry_behavior: Exponential backoff handling for GitHub API rate limits.
integrations.monitoring: Monitored via batch pipeline status dashboards.
integrations.sync_considerations: Bi-weekly scheduled extraction of repository documentation files.

integrations.name: SharePoint Runbooks Ingestion
integrations.target_system: Enterprise Vector and Hybrid Search Index
integrations.auth_approach: OAuth 2.0 access tokens via Microsoft Graph API.
integrations.error_handling: Access failures are logged and trigger administrative notification alerts.
integrations.retry_behavior: Exponential backoff up to 3 retries for transient HTTP errors.
integrations.monitoring: Tracked via ingestion orchestrator metrics and alert logs.
integrations.sync_considerations: Bi-weekly batch schedule to update engineering runbook vectors.

integrations.validation_reason: Requires confirmation of metadata cut-off thresholds for closed tickets.
integrations.name: Zendesk Historical Ticket Archive Ingestion
integrations.target_system: Enterprise Vector and Hybrid Search Index
integrations.error_handling: Outdated or deprecated tickets are filtered out and cataloged in audit logs.
integrations.retry_behavior: Batch job retries failed API calls up to 3 times.
integrations.monitoring: Monitored via data processing logs and deprecation filter counts.
integrations.sync_considerations: Applies 24-month cutoff filters and tag deprecation rules during index generation.
